open.speaker: abiba
open.text: Let me guess. Dr. Sarpong sent you. She sends me all the lost ones.

choices.text: She did. Could I join your study circle?
Does she send you people so you'll tutor them for free?

circle.speaker: abiba
circle.text: Tuesdays and Thursdays, second floor, by the window that doesn't open. Come with your own pen. People who borrow pens don't come back.

new.speaker: abiba
new.text: Everybody is new once. Some of us stay new for a whole semester.

free.speaker: abiba
free.text: She sends them because I pass. You can find another tutor if you like. They'll charge you.

party.speaker: abiba
party.text: If you're looking for everyone else, they've gone to KB's "welcome party" at the Student Centre. Free jollof, long speeches. Campaign season starts early here.

choices.text: I'll go and see for myself.

no.speaker: abiba
no.text: I have a circuits problem set and a scholarship to keep. Enjoy the rice.

kb.speaker: abiba
kb.text: KB is not bad. He is loud. Loud people get believed. Quiet people get blamed. Go — eat.

see.speaker: abiba
see.text: Good. Seeing for yourself is the whole of Dr. Sarpong's course anyway.
